# Glossary

_Abbreviations, notation and terms. Generated by `tools/ba sync` from glossary.yaml; edit the sources, not this file._

## Abbreviations

| Acronym | Reference |
|---|---|
| <a id="TERM-003"></a>BR | Business rule. BR-NNN is a policy or common rule shared by use cases; UC-NNN-BR-nn is a step rule of one use case |
| <a id="TERM-004"></a>CBR | Common business rule: a business rule of kind COMMON, applied by reference in several use cases |
| <a id="TERM-009"></a>CFD | Confirmation dialog message |
| <a id="TERM-005"></a>CMUC | Common use case: a reusable specification of one standard operation (view list, create, read, update, delete, disable) |
| <a id="TERM-007"></a>EMSG | Error message shown in a dialog |
| <a id="TERM-006"></a>ET | Email template (ET-NNN) |
| <a id="TERM-023"></a>HR | Human Resources |
| <a id="TERM-008"></a>IEM | In-line error message shown under a field |
| <a id="TERM-011"></a>INF | Informing or warning message |
| <a id="TERM-014"></a>N/A | Not applicable or not available |
| <a id="TERM-012"></a>NFR | Non-functional requirement |
| <a id="TERM-024"></a>PM | Project Manager |
| <a id="TERM-010"></a>SCD | Success dialog message |
| <a id="TERM-001"></a>SRS | System Requirement Specification |
| <a id="TERM-002"></a>UC | Use case: one function an actor performs in the system (UC-NNN) |
| <a id="TERM-022"></a>URS | User Requirement Specification: the client's requirement document for the Leave Request Management System (v1.0, 2025-05-09) |

## Notation

| Notation | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <a id="TERM-017"></a>"Value" | A literal value, e.g. "Pending approval" |
| <a id="TERM-020"></a>(n) | Step n of an activities flow; step rules are keyed by it |
| <a id="TERM-019"></a><<Field>> | The value of a field filled into an email template, e.g. <<Employee Name>> |
| <a id="TERM-018"></a><Value> | A special value the system supplies, e.g. <Today>, <Current User> |
| <a id="TERM-015"></a>[Field] | A field or attribute, e.g. [Start date] |
| <a id="TERM-021"></a>O / O* / O** / X | Permission matrix: allowed / allowed on the items the user owns / allowed within the scope the function states / not allowed |
| <a id="TERM-016"></a>{Object} | A record of an object, e.g. {Leave Request} |

## Terms

| Term | Definition |
|---|---|
| <a id="TERM-044"></a>Admin/HR | A user role: manages leave entitlement data, the annual refresh and the leave type rules. The URS also writes 'HR/Admin', 'HR' and 'Admin'. |
| <a id="TERM-029"></a>Annual refresh | The yearly refresh of leave data, managed by Admin/HR. |
| <a id="TERM-037"></a>Approval | Step 2 of the review workflow: the Line Manager approves or rejects a confirmed leave request, within the calendar month of the leave start date. |
| <a id="TERM-036"></a>Auto-confirmation | The automatic completion of the confirmation step when a Project Manager submits a leave request for themselves. |
| <a id="TERM-055"></a>Cancelled | The status of a leave request that was not confirmed and approved by the end of the calendar month of its leave start date. |
| <a id="TERM-046"></a>Card scanner system | The company's existing time tracking system, in which employees record check-in and check-out with a card. It provides the check-in/check-out times; its processing logic is out of scope. |
| <a id="TERM-047"></a>Check-in / check-out time | The times an employee's arrival and departure are recorded by the card scanner system. |
| <a id="TERM-035"></a>Confirmation | Step 1 of the review workflow: the Project Manager the employee chose from their assigned projects confirms or denies the leave request, within the calendar month of the leave start date. |
| <a id="TERM-045"></a>Dashboard | A role-specific screen for Project Managers and Line Managers that by default shows only the leave requests requiring their action. |
| <a id="TERM-038"></a>Deny | The Project Manager's negative decision at the confirmation step. The employee may modify and resubmit the request. |
| <a id="TERM-041"></a>Employee | A user role: submits leave requests and views their status. |
| <a id="TERM-053"></a>Half day | Leave for the morning or the afternoon of a day. Leave is requested and counted in full days and half days. |
| <a id="TERM-056"></a>HR systems | The company's existing human resources systems, from which the people and organisation data (employees, organisational structure, Line Managers, project assignments and Project Managers) are imported. |
| <a id="TERM-054"></a>Leave balance | The part of an employee's leave entitlement not yet used. It does not go below 0: when a request that exceeds it is approved, the balance stays at 0. |
| <a id="TERM-027"></a>Leave entitlement | The leave an employee is entitled to, which varies with seniority and gender. HR/Admin imports it for each employee at the beginning of each year. |
| <a id="TERM-025"></a>Leave request | An employee's request to be absent for a period, in full or half days, under one leave type. It is submitted by the employee, confirmed or denied by the chosen Project Manager, then approved or rejected by the Line Manager. A request not confirmed and approved by the end of its leave start month is cancelled. |
| <a id="TERM-026"></a>Leave type | A category of leave (e.g. Paid Leave, Maternity Leave) with its own eligibility rules (gender, seniority) and documentation requirements, configured by Admin/HR. |
| <a id="TERM-043"></a>Line Manager | A user role: approves or rejects leave requests confirmed by the Project Manager. |
| <a id="TERM-031"></a>Maternity Leave | A leave type available only to female employees. |
| <a id="TERM-049"></a>Off-work day | A day on which an employee has no check-in time recorded, or a total presence of less than 4 hours. |
| <a id="TERM-051"></a>Organisational structure | The company's organisation as the system holds it: countries, cities and offices, and the units and departments used for access and reporting. |
| <a id="TERM-030"></a>Paid Leave | A leave type whose entitlement is based on the employee's seniority. |
| <a id="TERM-034"></a>Policy violation | A leave request that does not satisfy the leave policy. It may still be submitted but is subject to manual review by the Line Manager. Exceeding the remaining leave balance is an allowed violation; if the request is approved, the balance stays at 0. |
| <a id="TERM-048"></a>Presence time | The total time an employee is present on a day, according to the card scanner check-in/check-out times. |
| <a id="TERM-042"></a>Project Manager | A user role: confirms or denies the leave requests of the members of their project team. Their own leave requests are auto-confirmed. |
| <a id="TERM-039"></a>Reject | The Line Manager's negative decision at the approval step. The employee may modify and resubmit the request. |
| <a id="TERM-040"></a>Resubmit | To modify a denied or rejected leave request and submit it again for review. |
| <a id="TERM-028"></a>Seniority | An employee's years of service. The entitlement of some leave types, such as Paid Leave, depends on it according to government regulations. |
| <a id="TERM-032"></a>Sick Leave (with Hospital Certificate) | A leave type that requires the employee to upload a hospital certificate with the request. The URS also calls it 'Medical Leave with Hospital Certificate'. |
| <a id="TERM-033"></a>Supporting document | A document a leave type requires the employee to upload with a leave request (e.g. a hospital certificate), as defined in the leave type's settings. |
| <a id="TERM-050"></a>Weekly attendance notification | The notification sent to employees every Friday listing the days they were off work without a leave request and the days they were off work with a valid leave request. |
